verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, built from physics, rendering, sensor-simulation and transport libraries. Operational fleet alerting on deployed robots' faults, battery and connectivity is outside that product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Gazebo shipping any alerting or fleet-monitoring capability; console verbosity flags and pub/sub transport are unrelated building blocks.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can get alerts on robot faults, battery, and connectivity so issues are caught before customers notice
